recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, surreal photograph featuring a person's head with a large afro emerging from dark, textured soil. The subject is captured in a mid-scream expression, with wide eyes and open mouth, framed by a dark, earthy environment that transitions into a black void at the top. The typography is hand-rendered and vibrant, providing a stark contrast to the organic, somber tones of the photography.
coreVisualRelationships: The central head acts as the primary focal point against a dark, textured ground.
The orange typography creates a vibrant, energetic counterpoint to the dark soil.
The circular shape of the afro mimics the organic mounds of the surrounding earth.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The head is centered horizontally, positioned slightly below the vertical midline, occupying approximately 30% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open mouth and teeth provide a bright, high-contrast anchor in the center of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central face, moves upward to the top text, then down through the soil to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space at the top (black) and bottom (textured soil) creates a sense of isolation and depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark brown and black provide the atmospheric, earthy base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Flesh tones and white (teeth/eyes) provide the primary visual contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange is used exclusively for the typography to draw attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment versus high saturation in the text; high value contrast on the face.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight, rounded sans-serif with irregular, organic edges.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters have a 'melted' or organic quality to match the psychedelic theme.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single custom typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain thematic unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s psychedelic aesthetic and rounded forms.
Matches the organic, soft-edged nature of the afro and soil.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast photograph of a person with a large afro buried up to their neck in dark, crumbly soil. The person has an intense, screaming expression. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting the face and the texture of the dirt. The top of the frame fades into pure black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn, bold, rounded uppercase lettering in a vibrant orange color. Place one word at the top center and a two-word phrase at the bottom center, following a slight organic arch.

verificationChecks: Is the face the primary focal point?
Is the soil texture visible and detailed?
Is the orange text vibrant and legible against the dark background?
Does the afro form a distinct circular silhouette?

adjustableVariables: Density and texture of the soil
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individual
Exact letterforms of the brand name
Specific placement of pebbles in the soil
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the transition from soil to black background is smooth.
Check that the teeth and eyes provide necessary highlights.
Verify the orange text has a hand-painted, slightly irregular quality.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the heavy negative space.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-intensity, high-contrast portrait of a head emerging from an organic medium (soil, water, sand) with vibrant, hand-drawn psychedelic typography in a complementary accent color.
